# NextFluent · Inglês sem Fronteiras

> Free, complete English course written in Portuguese for Brazilian learners, organized by CEFR level (A1 to C2, the full official scale). Each lesson has a grammar explanation, vocabulary, a model dialogue, exercises, and an answer key. A dedicated track covers professional/workplace English (resumes, interviews, meetings, negotiation).

This site is a static collection of Markdown lessons hosted on GitHub Pages. All explanations are in Portuguese; examples, dialogues, and exercises are in English. Content is organized into 6 CEFR levels (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2) plus one extra module focused on English for the job market. Source repository: https://github.com/Vaz2984/curso-English

## Start here

- [README](https://vaz2984.github.io/nextfluent/README.md): Course overview, full structure, and navigation.
- [Guia de Estudos](https://vaz2984.github.io/nextfluent/GUIA-DE-ESTUDOS.md): Suggested pace, daily routine, and level-advancement criteria.
- [Cadastro Setup](https://vaz2984.github.io/nextfluent/CADASTRO-SETUP.md): Optional Supabase-backed student accounts (sign-up, cross-device progress, admin dashboard) and how to turn them on.
